description: Join a premier skilled nursing facility in Gainesville, FL, as an MDS Coordinator. This is an excellent opportunity for an RN or LPN to step into a crucial role, working alongside an experienced lead MDS Coordinator. You'll contribute to a facility renowned for its commitment to quality, evidenced by recent outstanding survey results and a 5-star rating for Quality Measures.This 148-bed facility maintains an average Medicare A census of 15-20, providing a stable and manageable workload. We are seeking a dedicated professional to help ensure accurate and timely resident assessments, contributing to comprehensive care planning and regulatory compliance. If you are a detail-oriented MDS professional looking to thrive in a supportive environment with a strong team, we encourage you to apply. This full-time position offers the chance to make a significant impact on resident care and facility success.
requirements: Active RN or LPN license in Florida
Minimum of 1 year of recent experience as an MDS Coordinator
Strong understanding of the Resident Assessment Instrument (RAI) process
Proficiency with Medicare and Medicaid regulations related to MDS
